logo.description: Black angular shield with neon chartreuse outline; orange flame + crossed spatula/fork; MIDTOWN in bold distressed white display; SMOKEHOUSE in smaller tracked white/yellow sans.

typography.display_midtown: Heavy condensed distressed sans/serif hybrid matching logo MIDTOWN (Impact/Bebas-like grit — prefer using logo asset over approximating)
typography.smokehouse_sub: Clean wide-tracked all-caps sans (smaller than MIDTOWN)
typography.accent_banner: Bold brush/slanted sans for location chips (yellow stroke banners)
typography.rule: Never invent a scripty elegant face; brand is industrial BBQ.

imagery_style: High-contrast food photography, ember/coal backgrounds, storefront brick, torn-paper/burnt edges on promos, warm orange-red fire accents.
constraints: KEEP official logo artwork from logos/ as-is
Match neon chartreuse + flame orange + charcoal from social
Match typography feel to logo lockup
